slice: Bind imported classic POINTCLOUD source fields for a bounded reference-free profile

profile.fixture_policy: ASCII and Binary sources authored locally at runtime in temporary paths; no fixture files added

joins: physical POINTCLOUD record to one parser dispatch
dispatch to one typed parser callback and observed source model
observed model identity and every modeled classic POINTCLOUD field to the retained output entity
physical_checks: complete ordered record spans and exact AcDbEntity then AcDbPointCloud subclass markers
common handle, modelspace owner, common entity fields and body reference fields
supported coordinate, source-file, count, UCS and intensity fields
required and optional field types, cardinalities, and source-file order
no unrepresented fields, clipping payload, intensity display, or nonzero definition/reactor references
source_binding.inventory: every retained classic POINTCLOUD must bind exactly once; named-BLOCK records cannot be paired by this ENTITIES-only route and therefore remain refused

ascii_and_binary: locally authored AC1027 import, exact-revision output and fresh typed readback
mutated retained point count is refused before output and preserves the destination
restored point count succeeds on the same adapter and binds exactly one physical source entity
readback verifies class version, source filename/list, point count, reference handles, UCS name and axes
ascii_only: a duplicated physical class-version field imports tolerantly but fails strict source binding and preserves a pre-existing destination

limitations: No physical producer coverage or native consumer semantics are established.
Named-BLOCK, paper-space, DWG-source and cross-revision profiles remain refused or unqualified.
Nonzero definition/reactor graph closure, external asset loading and 3D semantics remain open.
support_claim_effect: None; this adds generated source-to-output transport evidence only.
